{"draft": "Vertiv Q4 2025: Exceptional orders drive a strong finish
Vertiv delivered a powerful fourth quarter, with demand for AI infrastructure lifting sales, profitability and backlog sharply.

Fourth-quarter net sales reached $2,880 million, climbing 23% from fourth quarter 2024, driven by organic sales growth of 19%. Momentum in orders accelerated markedly, as organic orders surged approximately 252% versus last year's fourth quarter and jumped 117% sequentially from third quarter 2025. The book-to-bill ratio was ~2.9x, while backlog expanded to $15.0 billion, up 109% from the same period last year.

Profitability improved alongside the volume growth. Operating profit rose to $580 million, up 27%, and adjusted operating profit climbed to $668 million, up 33%. Adjusted operating margin widened to 23.2%, up 170 basis points from fourth quarter 2024, helped by operational leverage on higher volume, productivity and favorable price-cost, partially offset by tariff impact.

Cash generation was equally strong. Operating cash flow totaled $1,005 million in the quarter and adjusted free cash flow was $910 million. Liquidity remained strong at $2.6 billion, with net leverage of approximately 0.5x at the end of the fourth quarter, leaving the balance sheet well positioned after the quarter's strategic growth acquisitions.

Outlook: For full year 2026, Vertiv expects net sales of $13,250 million to $13,750 million, with organic sales growth of 27% to 29% compared to 2025. It also expects adjusted diluted EPS of $5.97 to $6.07, pointing to continued momentum as the year begins."}
